title: Verification order
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 1. The pipeline at a glance; QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards. QR Code Generation, 1. The pipeline at a glance: “A verifier runs the same list upwards.”.

statements.label: Verification order
statements.requirement: The verifier SHALL run the QR Code Generation section 11 sequence in order: prefix, Base45, inflate, COSE parse, header validation, trust lookup by kid, signature verification, EKU check, CWT decode and time checks, subclaim dispatch, business rules.
